name: jahjah-tools
description: Jahjah's commands, read-only log helper, and routine-work permission mod

approval_mode.title: Routine approvals
approval_mode.description: Approve supported routine work automatically, or turn this mod's approvals off. Existing deny rules and managed controls remain in force.

trusted_merge_actors.title: Trusted PR authors
trusted_merge_actors.description: Explicit GitHub login:numeric-account-ID pairs. Bot status or a claimed owner approval is never enough. Only same-repository PRs qualify; project checks and reviews still apply.

repositories.title: Authorized repositories
repositories.description: Comma-separated owner/repo names. Only these GitHub repositories receive automatic approvals.
